title: Where is the subway station?
subtitle: 지하철역이 어디예요?
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: A traveller asks the way to the subway station. Listen for where to turn and how far it is.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

tr.en: Excuse me. Where is the subway station?
The subway station? Go straight ahead.
Yes. Then turn right at the bank.
Yes, about five minutes on foot.
I see. Thank you very much.

questions.q: What is the traveller looking for?
questions.why: Jihacheollyeogi eodiyeyo? = Where is the subway station?
Eunhaengeseo oreunjjogeuro doseyo = Turn right at the bank.
Georeoseo o bun jeongdo = about five minutes on foot.

notes: jjuk = straight ahead. oreunjjok = right. oenjjok = left.
...seyo = please do ...: gaseyo (please go), doseyo (please turn).
georeoseo o bun = five minutes on foot.
jihacheol (subway) + yeok (station) is said jihacheollyeok: an l sound appears where the two words join.
